description: This Java class 'Filter' is part of the 'com.android.mkstubs' package and manages inclusion and exclusion patterns for filtering strings. It provides methods to get pattern sets and determines if a given string should be accepted based on these patterns.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Manages include/exclude pattern sets and determines if strings pass the filter.

methods.name: getIncludeFull
methods.description: Returns the set of all full patterns to be included.

methods.name: getIncludePrefix
methods.description: Returns the set of all prefix patterns to be included.

methods.name: getExcludeFull
methods.description: Returns the set of all full patterns to be excluded.

methods.name: getExcludePrefix
methods.description: Returns the set of all prefix patterns to be excluded.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Checks if a string passes the include/exclude rules based on patterns.
